name: afs-console-security-headers
description: Response headers for the console distribution. Replace the <placeholders> from the environment's config.json; the platform Terraform consumes this file.

placeholders.<issuers>: space-separated origins of every sign-in provider issuer (providersFallback and ListSignInProviders)
placeholders.<telemetryUrl>: config.telemetryUrl origin, omitted when telemetry is off

headers.Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' <apiUrl> <issuers> <telemetryUrl>; frame-src 'self' <issuers>; frame-ancestors 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'
